integrations.name: Screen Time Tracker Nova
integrations.detail: 5.7.0 on cloud/nova: Pro bound to the Gmail (no license key), one trial per Google account, community open to guests with a live feed, plan-refresh loop fixed, buffering instead of full-screen loading. Nova dpl pool fix deployed.

decisions.text: Screen Time Tracker: no license keys. Pro and the 7-day trial are tied to the signed-in Google account (payment server + Nova); guests must sign in to buy or trial; a used trial lands on the plans.

Screen Time Tracker community: every post is public to guests and members; guests can open profiles; a new post shows on every open Community screen within 20 s; screens buffer in place, never a full loading wipe.

activity.detail: Screen Time Tracker 5.7.0 built and verified in the headless harness (guest + member), pushed to cloud/nova at 56ec895; store publish still needs Boss YES.
Screen Time Tracker: plan-refresh loop (35 cloud calls per second after a forced check) found in Nova logs and removed; this was the loading/lag bug.
